title: Patch: the board says Canceled, Countered and Draw limit, and the turn banner says when a turn was cut short or the AI took it, with effects on or off
thread:
**Issue #3910 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3910: Patch: the board says Canceled, Countered and Draw limit, and the turn banner says when a turn was cut short or the AI took it, with effects on or off
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some moments at the table happen without a word on the board. When a card cancels an attack, the attacker snaps back in a puff of smoke. When a Spell is countered, it cracks and drops. When a card stops a draw, the deck shakes. The design table for these moments promises a short tag for each (Canceled, Countered, Draw limit), but none is drawn, so a player has to open the game log to learn what happened.

Two more moments, Turn cut short and The AI takes the turn, are painted only by the visual-effects layer. A player who turns effects off, or listens with a screen reader, never gets them: the turn banner just goes on saying Your turn. Once this is built, each moment shows its words on the board itself, in English and Chinese, whatever the effects setting.

## Why

BUILD M5-T4's event table promises the words:

- `attackCancelled`: the attacker snaps back with a “Canceled” tag; acceptance “tag visible” (BUILD.md:565).
- `countered`: the card cracks under a “Countered” tag; acceptance “tag ‘Countered’ visible” (574).
- `drawLimited`: the deck shakes under a “Draw limit” tag (590).
- `turnCutShort`: a banner; acceptance “banner text” (592).
- `autopilotEngaged`: a banner “The AI takes the turn”; acceptance “banner text” (605).

What the client draws today:

- “Canceled”, “Countered” and “Draw limit” appear nowhere under `apps/web/src`, the zh-CN file included. Those three events get only a smoke puff and a sound (`apps/web/src/game/animations.ts:436`, `apps/web/src/fx/cues.ts:775`, `apps/web/src/audio/cues.ts:572, 659`).
- The board already draws pile notices for their events: “Fatigue N”, “Deck full” and “Hand full” (`apps/web/src/game/OverflowNotices.tsx:18`, `NOTICE_EVENTS = [fatigue, libraryOverflow, burned]`). `drawLimited`, on the same deck pile, is left out.
- “Turn cut short” and “The AI takes the turn” exist only in `FX_TEXT` (`apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts`), drawn by `fx/cues.ts:788-790` into the effects layer. That layer is `aria-hidden` and draws nothing when effects are Off or motion is reduced (`apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx:152`).
- The board's own `turn-banner` is the `role=status` live region (`apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx:977`). It takes its words from `bannerText`, which knows only `turnStarted` and `turnAutoEnded` (`Game.tsx:130-149`).

## Proposal

- Add `drawLimited` to `NOTICE_EVENTS`, with a `drawLimit` pile-notice kind and a “Draw limit” tag on that seat's deck pile, drawn as “Deck full” is.
- Have the board, not the effects layer, draw a “Canceled” tag on the attacker while `attackCancelled` plays, and a “Countered” tag on the held card while `countered` plays. Each tag goes on the element the table's acceptance names.
- Teach `isTurnEvent` and `bannerText` about `turnCutShort` and `autopilotEngaged`, reusing `FX_TEXT`'s words, which already have zh-CN entries.
- Bring BUILD's `turnCutShort` row into line with the words shown. The row says “Turn ended” and the effect says “Turn cut short”; one of them changes in the same PR.
- Add zh-CN entries for the new words.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/game/OverflowNotices.tsx` and its CSS
- `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx`, and the components that carry the attacker's and the held card's `data-animating`
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`
- BUILD.md, M5-T4's `turnCutShort` row and any row whose words change

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `noticesFrom`, with a deck pile animating `drawLimited`, returns a `drawLimit` notice, and `PileNotice` renders “Draw limit” on that side's pile, for each side.
- [ ] While `attackCancelled` plays, the attacker's element holds a tag reading “Canceled”. While `countered` plays, the held card holds “Countered”. Both render with effects Off.
- [ ] A Game test with fake timers, in the style of `game/turn-start-bleed.test.tsx`: a burst of `turnCutShort`, `turnEnded`, `turnStarted` shows `turn-banner` reading “Turn cut short” during the first entry and the next turn's words after the last.
- [ ] In the same style, `autopilotEngaged` reads “The AI takes the turn” until the next `turnStarted`.
- [ ] The i18n guard passes with the new zh-CN entries, and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and every touched test file pass.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 100 lines plus tests, all in `apps/web`. There is no engine or wire change; the client renders events it already receives (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The risk is the turn banner's #37 hold-back around `burstTurn`. Under reduced motion every entry lasts 0 ms, so a tag shows only while its entry plays, as “Deck full” does today.
```
